entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback for semiconductor-chain organizations not fitting a specific domain type
entity_types.selection_rule: Any real company/org in the semiconductor chain that cannot be classified into the specific domain actor types below.

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Sovereign government bodies setting export controls, trade policy, and licensing

attributes.name: policy_instrument
attributes.description: Main lever type (export control, entity list, licensing)

entity_types.selection_rule: Government ministries/agencies whose export-control or trade decisions causally affect semiconductor supply through 2027.

entity_types.name: ChipDesigner
entity_types.description: Fabless accelerator/ASIC designers driving the AI bill-of-materials pull

attributes.name: cowos_share_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated share of 2026 CoWoS wafers held

entity_types.selection_rule: Fabless firms whose GPU/ASIC roadmaps determine HBM bits and packaging lanes demanded before end-2027.

entity_types.name: FoundryOperator
entity_types.description: Wafer foundries operating leading-edge or mature logic nodes and advanced packaging

attributes.name: packaging_capacity
attributes.description: Advanced packaging (CoWoS/SoIC) wpm estimates if known

entity_types.selection_rule: Companies operating logic wafer fabs, including those with in-house advanced packaging lines.

entity_types.name: MemoryManufacturer
entity_types.description: DRAM/HBM/NAND producers allocating wafers between HBM and mainstream memory

attributes.name: hbm_wpm_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated HBM wafer starts per month

entity_types.selection_rule: Producers of HBM/DRAM/NAND whose wafer-allocation decisions set memory tightness through 2027.
anti_examples: CXMT (insufficient evidence of causal role, keep only if instantiated)
levers: shift DRAM wafers to HBM lines
build inventory or run it down

entity_types.name: EquipmentSupplier
entity_types.description: Semiconductor equipment (litho, etch, deposition) suppliers gating all ramps

attributes.name: single_source_flag
attributes.description: yes/no whether sole source for its capability

entity_types.selection_rule: Toolmakers whose shipment and install throughput gates node and packaging ramps through 2027.

entity_types.name: MaterialSubstrateSupplier
entity_types.description: Suppliers of substrates, wafers, photoresist, films and specialty materials

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: ABF/BT substrate, 300mm wafer, photoresist, film, gases

attributes.name: capacity_share
attributes.description: Estimated share of high-end segment capacity

attributes.name: expansion_timing
attributes.description: Dated ramp timing of announced expansions

entity_types.selection_rule: Material/substrate/wafer suppliers whose concentration and dated expansions determine 2027 substrate and wafer tightness.

entity_types.name: OSATProvider
entity_types.description: Outsourced assembly and test providers absorbing packaging overflow

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high/medium/low influence on packaging bottleneck relief

entity_types.selection_rule: Back-end assembly/test companies whose 2027-28 expansion timing sets packaging overflow relief.

entity_types.name: SupplyChainSegment
entity_types.description: Trackable chain segment whose bottleneck status is the forecast target

attributes.name: segment_kind
attributes.description: packaging / HBM / logic / substrate / equipment / materials / memory / mature / OSAT

attributes.name: baseline_lead_time
attributes.description: Reported lead time as of late Oct 2026

attributes.name: bottleneck_probability
attributes.description: Forecast P of binding constraint before end-2027

entity_types.selection_rule: A named segment of the semiconductor supply chain being tracked as a candidate bottleneck, not a company.

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Source delivers wafers, tools, materials, or memory to target

attributes.name: single_source
attributes.description: yes/no if source is sole/primary supplier

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source supplies goods/capacity to target (e.g., ASML supplies TSMC).

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Source buys foundry/packaging/OSAT capacity from target

attributes.name: capacity_share_held
attributes.description: Share of target's constrained capacity reserved

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source is a customer buying capacity from target (e.g., NVIDIA customer of TSMC).

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Source's ramp or output depends on target's tools, materials, or capacity

attributes.name: lag
attributes.description: Time lag between constraint and impact

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source depends on target for a critical input (e.g., TSMC depends on ASML).

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Capacity reservation, joint investment, or strategic supply partnership

attributes.name: reservation_value
attributes.description: Dollar value of reservation/advance if disclosed

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source and target are strategic capacity partners (e.g., NVIDIA partners with IBIDEN).

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Competition for capacity, share, or qualification in the same segment

attributes.name: contested_ground
attributes.description: Segment where competition occurs (HBM4, 2nm, CoWoS lanes)

edge_types.direction_semantics: Symmetric rivalry: both parties compete for the same customers/capacity.

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Source exercises export-control, entity-list, or licensing authority over target

attributes.name: instrument
attributes.description: Entity list, licensing, affiliates rule, critical-mineral controls

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source regulator constrains target's exports/sales (e.g., BIS regulates SMIC).

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Inter-state trade-control confrontation or retaliatory measure
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source applies adversarial trade measures against target (e.g., MOFCOM opposes BIS).

edge_types.name: OWNS_CAPACITY
edge_types.description: Source owns or controls constrained capacity in a segment

attributes.name: beneficiary_flag
attributes.description: Whether owner benefits from the bottleneck

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source owns/controls capacity within the target segment (e.g., TSMC owns CoWoS capacity).

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Causal edge: source limits ramp or demand fulfillment in target segment

attributes.name: lag
attributes.description: Delay before constraint binds (e.g., 30-month tool lead times)

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's actions causally tighten or loosen the target segment (e.g., ASML constrains leading-edge logic; NVIDIA's BOM pull constrains HBM).

edge_types.name: BENEFITS_FROM
edge_types.description: Source gains pricing/overflow benefit from a tight segment

attributes.name: benefit_type
attributes.description: overflow orders, pricing power, share gains

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source captures economic benefit from the target segment's tightness (e.g., ASE benefits from CoWoS overflow).

analysis_summary: 预测问题聚焦2026年10月至2027年底全球半导体供应链各环节是否成为约束性瓶颈及严重程度。角色阵容以18个组织/政府为主体，核心决策者包括：需求端(NVIDIA/Broadcom的BOM拉动)、供给端(TSMC的CoWoS、SK Hynix/三星/美光的HBM晶圆分配)、单点设备与材料(ASML、信越、IBIDEN)，以及两个政府(BIS/MOFCOM)的出口管制悬崖(2026年11月9-10日到期)。本体保留Organization/Government种子类型，新增按产业链角色细分的6个能动类型(ChipDesigner/FoundryOperator/MemoryManufacturer/EquipmentSupplier/MaterialSubstrateSupplier/OSATProvider)和一个被追踪客体SupplyChainSegment(瓶颈环节)。关系覆盖实证关系(CUSTOMER_OF/SUPPLIES/DEPENDS_ON/PARTNERS_WITH/COMPETES_WITH/REGULATES/OPPOSES)，并新增OWNS_CAPACITY(产能归属)、CONSTRAINS(因果传导，带sign/lag/strength)与BENEFITS_FROM(受益方)三条预测高价值边，用于把'冲击如何传导到各环节瓶颈'结构化。TrendForce/SEMI等数据源不作为能动实体。
